items.title: Leopold Aschenbrenner Built a Hot A.I. Hedge Fund. Then It Melted Down.
items.desc: Situational Awareness, the AI-focused hedge fund led by the 24-year-old author of the influential 'Situational Awareness' essay, surged onto the scene on the AI-investment boom and then nose-dived — a cautionary tale about exuberance around AI bets meeting market reality. [NYT, posted 2026-07-31]
